## Description

The "swan's tear": a ~100 µm flask-shaped body with a neck that stretches up to 7–8 times that length
in seconds to catch ciliates and small flagellates. The neck is the anterior part of the cell, a
stretch of membrane that unfolds into a thin tube.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

The [neck](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) is part of the membrane ring (`game/world_neck.cpp`): it extends to
`neck_reach` towards prey and retracts. The body narrows towards the anterior pole.

## Literature

- Coyle S.M. et al. (2019) Curr. Biol. 29: R1192 (the neck as the anterior part of the cell).
